title: L1: Price→adoption — supported (dated primary snapshot), causal arrow contested
definition: Primary market-data snapshot as-of 2026-06-08: OpenRouter price spread ~51-460x (c010), HuggingFace Qwen/DeepSeek download dominance (c011), token-share 1.2%->~13% in a year (c012), population-rep usage with concentration AND diversity (c036). Containment: proves L1 adoption ONLY, never L4 cognition. The price-vs-capability causal-identification literature is in the Dr3 snippet pool.

title: L2: AI as information entry — thin, contested-trending ceiling
definition: Reuters DNR 2025 (c014) is the strongest L2 anchor because it SEPARATES chat-LLM news use (7%) from in-search AI Overviews (4%) — the mechanism distinction the brief mandates. c041 (FDD) operationalizes the intermediation channel (57% state-aligned-propaganda citation rate, incl. Taiwan-China arm). Only 2 deep-read members, 0 peer-reviewed: tier ceiling contested-trending. The -43%/-33% referral figures belong to Chartbeat/c015 (Dr3), NOT Reuters.

title: L3: Stable measurable framing — the STRONG link
definition: The chain's strongest link. Waight Nature 2026 (c002): strictly correlational cross-national + causal ONLY at model-output level, NO user-belief claim. Buyl (c003) + Samokhodskyi (c004): symmetric Western-model framing tests (false balance) guarding directional artifact. Repo abliteration killer-mechanism (c001): same model de-aligned produces Taiwan-mainstream framing -> bias is post-training/RLHF, not corpus absence; all origins remarkably similar. LOAD-BEARING boundary: L3 (output) != L4b (user belief).

title: L4a: Output homogenization — healthy, with disconfirming evidence preserved
definition: Kleinberg & Raghavan monoculture anchor (c017 — SCOPE: hiring/lending decision systems, not LLM info-output; LLM extension is open) + LLM-specific generative-monoculture demonstration (c018 — output-diversity narrowing, root cause in alignment processes). Disconfirming evidence deliberately kept inside: users run many models (c035, % inference) and population-rep concentration AND diversity coexist (c036). Does not straw-man L4a as settled.

conflicts.summary: c018 measures LLM output-diversity NARROWING (homogenization present); c035 shows users running MANY models (diversity rising) — opposing directions on whether single-model dominance produces homogenization.

title: L4b: Individual belief shift — RICH but BOUNDED (capability yes, scale no)
definition: Human-subject persuasion sources establishing LLM framing CAN move individual belief — every one foregrounding BOUNDEDNESS: Hackenburg (c026) frontier barely more persuasive than far smaller models; Chen/Kalla/Le (c027) not a greater threat to democratic societies than human methods, constrained by scale; Salvi (c024) non-significant without personalization (p=0.31); Shu/c028 small default d=0.14, conservative effect only in already-conservative subgroup (amplifies pre-existing leanings); Costello/c023 durable ~20% debunking-direction; c031 valence-symmetric. c027 and c028 carry highest over-read risk. Bounded individual capability != L4c population shift.

partial_counter_framing.reason: Scope-qualification rescue: no direct quote rebuts the chain's amplification claim; instead each RCT bounds its own effect (log-scaling cap, no-personalization null, subgroup-limited conservative arm) — the boundedness IS the caveat-level counter to L4b->L4c inflation.

title: L4c: Societal aggregation — the EMPTY CELL is the finding
definition: NO direct evidence links a single dominant intermediary's framing to population-scale cognitive shift. Only adjacent material: a framework that merely defines the emerging area (c032 Carley); an LLM-agent SIMULATION, not real humans, needing prompt-induced confirmation bias to look human-like (c033 Chuang); and a social-media agenda-setting ANALOGY (c034, fast-skip/Dr3, MUST be labelled analogy, never LLM L4c direct evidence). The empty cell is THE finding; write it as a research agenda.

title: THE BREAK POINT: the chain breaks at L4b->L4c (centerpiece)
definition: The report's load-bearing conclusion. One side: bounding L4b evidence (c026 log-scaling cap; c027 constrained by scale; c028 small subgroup-limited effect). Other side: empty L4c cell (c032 framework-only, c033 simulation-only) + the methodological caution that LLM output is NOT population opinion and must be used alongside conventional methodologies (c044). Synthesis: bounded individual persuasion is established; population-scale cognitive restructuring from a single dominant model is unproven -> the policy claim is CONDITIONAL on an L4c the evidence does not support. Carries the 'what study would close L4c' research-agenda material.

partial_counter_framing.reason: Mechanism-inference + scope-qualification rescue: the break is the counter to the chain's landing claim — L4b sources bound their own scale and c044 explicitly cautions LLM output != population opinion; no source asserts L4c, so the counter-position is the absence-plus-caveat, not a direct rebuttal quote.

title: Cognitive-infrastructure frameworks (conditional-policy grounding) — deep-read thin
definition: Grounds the spec's borrowed labels (cognitive security / information sovereignty / gatekeeper) in real literature. Deep-read members thin: c032 (Carley social-cybersecurity vocabulary) + c041 (FDD intermediation-channel audit / FW-L2-L3 bridge, incl. paywall-asymmetry structural mechanism). Substantive sovereignty / DMA-gatekeeper anchors (c037, c038, c039, c040) are fast-skip / Dr3 snippet-layer — cite at contested ceiling with snippet annotation. Structurally thin theme; flagged in handoff.

title: Counter-evidence / §6 — anti-alarmism as its own theme
definition: Operationalizes the spec's §6 so the report stays in the governance-under-uncertainty frame: bias originates in RLHF/safety/alignment design, NOT necessarily political intent (c042); framing is prompt/language-contingent and mutable, all origins converge remarkably similar (c043); disconfirming homogenization — users run many models, diversity coexists with concentration (c035, c036); methodological caution that one cannot infer population opinion from LLM output (c044). Must be its own section, not buried. The adoption-is-capability-not-price counter (c008, c009) lives in the Dr3 snippet pool.

partial_counter_framing.reason: Mechanism-inference rescue: bias attributed to RLHF/safety/commercial design rather than political intent (c042/c043), plus disconfirming-evidence and scope-qualification (c044) — these are the §6 incorrect-inference rebuttals that prevent an anti-China alarmist read.
